# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

* v0.1 – v0.5

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a vulnerability, please open an issue or email security@github.com. We aim to respond within 72 hours.

## Known Vulnerabilities

All known vulnerabilities are addressed via Dependabot. Review the Dependabot alerts for the latest status.
